Desen supervises faithful copying of V's handwritten notes, records that these are transcriptions of records observed by V rather than authenticated original Veldrake exhibits, and issues signed evidence receipt enumerating both originals and the copy; receipt retained by Cirren, V retains original handwritten notes. Desen takes responsibility for coordinating actual lawful recovery of paymaster48gp and customs investigation; recovery and official corroboration not yet accomplished. Cirren favors finding who personally authorized L-9 purchases; Mara offers to compare public household and commercial records at Exchange, not yet undertaken. Desen will handle official investigation without making party chase routine clerical approvals. Party remains at annex pending V's next action; no roll, resource change, further disclosure or departure. All other counters, obligations, provenance and knowledge boundaries unchanged.
